profile.address: Avenida San Jorge / San Jorge Etorbidea, 81, Pamplona/Iruña, Navarra, Spain
profile.reading:
This is one of the two data processing centres of the Government of Navarra, in Pamplona in northern Spain, operated by NASERTIC. This record covers the centre on the Carretera de Sarriguren in the Beloso area of eastern Pamplona, postcode 31016. The OpenStreetMap point sits on a building outline that already carried a NASERTIC operator tag before the data centre point was added, which is useful corroboration that the company occupies the site. The two Navarra rows in this registry are not duplicates of each other. The mapper who added them in March 2026 stated in the changeset comment that both data processing centres of the Government of Navarra were being added, and the second lies about three kilometres west on Calle de Orcoyen in the San Juan district, one level below ground, at NASERTIC's registered head office. An address on Avenida San Jorge recorded against these rows in an earlier pass belongs to NASERTIC's telecommunications and digitalisation office rather than to either data centre.

NASERTIC, in full Navarra de Servicios y Tecnologias S.A.U., is the public technology company of the regional government. It forms part of the Corporacion Publica Empresarial de Navarra and is attached to the Department of the Presidency and Equality, describes more than forty years of operating history and a staff of more than 180 professionals, and states that it does not seek profit and does not compete with private firms.

The original data centre was delivered in 2017 as a container based prefabricated modular facility built to Tier III availability standards, completed in five months against a typical eighteen to thirty six month timeline for comparable projects, at an investment of 1.28 million euros. It was developed jointly by NASERTIC, Aquads Technologies and Schneider Electric, designed to operate alongside NASERTIC's existing data centre for redundancy, and won an innovation prize from Data Center Market magazine for the best containerised centre at Tier III availability.

In December 2023 the Navarra government declared a major expansion and modernisation of the centre an investment of regional interest, a designation granting preferential and expedited treatment across Navarra's public administration procedures. Engineering documentation for the 2024 to 2025 expansion phase describes a 1,258 square metre technical space with 270 racks rated at 100 kilowatts each, an initial electrical service of 20 megawatts expandable to 40 megawatts across five 4 megawatt transformers, which is utility supply capacity rather than IT load, and an uninterruptible power supply rated at 1 megawatt in a 2N configuration. Cooling runs on four separate thermal circuits, a condensation loop, direct liquid cooling, rear door heat exchangers and ambient cooling, supported by evaporative cooling towers rated at 17 megawatts of heat rejection. The design also includes VESDA smoke detection, a custom building management system and smart water management. NASERTIC describes the centre as carrying digital services for Navarra's citizens, its regional administration and its public enterprises.

Which of the two Pamplona sites the 2017 container unit and the 2024 expansion each belong to is not stated in any source checked here, so the project detail above is recorded against both rows rather than assigned to one and guessed at for the other.
profile.research_note: Corrected 2026-09-05. The prior note on both Navarra rows claimed near-identical coordinates and treated them as possible duplicates. That is wrong. Changeset 179192155 (2026-03-01, user Agazzr, imagery SITNA + PNOA) is commented "Anadidos los dos Centros de Procesamiento de Datos del Gobierno de Navarra", explicitly adding two distinct centres, and the objects are about 3 km apart. This row, node/13608563509, reverse-geocodes to Carretera de Sarriguren, Beloso, Pamplona 31016 and falls on way/127615729, a building already tagged operator=Nasertic independently of this edit. The sibling way/1484174881 carries level=-1 and reverse-geocodes to Calle de Orcoyen, San Juan, Pamplona 31011, matching NASERTIC's published head office address C/ Orkoien s/n. The Avenida San Jorge 81 address previously recorded in the profile is NASERTIC's Telco y Digitalizacion office (31012) per the company's own contact page. Corporate facts taken fresh from nasertic.es. Power figures relabelled: 20 MW rising to 40 MW is utility service capacity, not IT load. Which site hosts the 2017 container unit versus the 2024-25 expansion is not stated in any source found, and the page says so rather than guessing.
